activities.description: Ayham continues talking, highlighting achievements since 2012 and mentioning collaborations in North Africa, Morocco, Algeria, and the Middle East.

Discusses collaboration with law enforcement agencies in the UAE, capacity building, and training programs. Mentions involvement of different departments like police, customs, prosecutors, health protection, and consumer agencies.
Focuses on collaboration with 16 countries in the Middle East and North Africa, emphasizing sharing ideas, information, experience, and the need for further involvement to combat illicit goods.
